decisions.decision: Board members agreed to refer all budget questions to the Director rather than approach the Town Manager, as the Director had asked at the prior meeting.

decisions.decision: Each COA board member agreed to take one day to bring goodies for the Eagle House volunteers during volunteer appreciation week (April 18-24), choosing their days.

decisions.decision: All board members were reminded that COA sub committees must have end of year reports prepared for the COA June Annual Meeting.

decisions.decision: Members were reminded to prepare a slate of officers for the next year, to be presented at the May COA meeting and voted on at the June Annual COA meeting.

decisions.decision: The Advocacy and Board Development committees will meet before the May 11, 2010 COA meeting; the Administrative Assistant will post dates and times with the Town Clerk.
